source_title: Cancellation semantics: a level-triggered contract for agent runs, streams, tools, and durable execution
pain_statement: An AI-agent run can be cancelled while a tool or durable activity may already have performed an external side effect; its final real-world outcome may be uncertain unless the system records and reconciles the effect.
economic_consequence: HYPOTHESIS: duplicate payments/orders, lost confirmations, manual reconciliation or unsafe retries; specific loss amount and paying organization are not established by the public issue.
payer_role: HYPOTHESIS: engineering/platform owner of a production AI workflow that invokes externally-effecting tools; no named budget owner yet.
observed_workaround: Issue discussion emphasizes preserving completed tool results and, in related discussion, reconciling unknown external effects by idempotency key. Actual buyer workaround is not yet verified.
evidence_excerpt: The public issue describes silent successful completion after an absorbed CancelledError and states that cancellation outcome and message history must be handled separately. A commenter raises the adjacent risk that a payment/message/file mutation may have committed before its tool return was recorded.
notes: Research hypothesis only. Related PRs #6496, #6497 and #6498 are merged, so do not duplicate framework fixes. Investigate the residual cross-system effect-reconciliation layer and buyer/payer proof, not the already-merged cancellation implementation.

source_title: Android brake stage: declare BRAKE_NOTES_LINE and harden '; ' replace-last
pain_statement: A semicolon-space inside a release-note entry may be mistaken for an entry separator and truncate part of the change note.
economic_consequence: HYPOTHESIS: inaccurate release notes and weaker release review evidence; no quantified loss or budget identified.
payer_role: HYPOTHESIS: mobile-release / engineering owner; not verified.
observed_workaround: The issue says the current flow fails safe before Play edits and reads the replacement back, limiting immediate damage.
notes: The issue contains a concrete narrow reliability bug but a commenter-proposed $50 follow-up is not evidence that maintainers funded or approved a bounty. Keep below the Pydantic side-effect-reconciliation hypothesis for value research.
